output:
[review by vseehausen]
Great PR that consolidates the design and is a step towards the new design system. 

I added a few comments that will make the design system even more consistent in the future.

---

apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/Members/index.tsx:21
We should not rely on hooks for dark mode, ideally. Dark mode should be set globally and then affed stylesheets.

---

apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/Members/index.tsx:34
Let's use only variants and sizes, no custom styling on standard components.

---

apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:64
The font-bold/line-through/duplicate-dimming is data-specific and fine at the call site. But column.className is applied to headers only — body cells are hand-rendered, so every caller re-implements column layout. Consider per-column cell renderers so the table owns structural styling for both header and body.

---

apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:109
Same here, this should be done by `renderRow` at the Table component.
